frozen_before: any model in this study was fitted or scored; written after the NFL study, so the engine and metric set were already fixed
market_family: CFB full-game lines: winner, point spread, total points (FBS-involved games)
dataset_builder: alpha_engine.features.cfb_cfbd_v2 via training_sets_multi cfb --cfb-builder v2 (certified v2.2)
prediction_cutoff: scheduled kickoff (cutoff_utc); in-season columns use games strictly before the game date, priors are season-level preseason values
labels: final score from the certified dataset. Kalshi official CFB results are NOT joined in this study (346 exchange events lack a team-identity join; total-ladder strike semantics differ between 2025 and 2026): contract-level scoring is deferred
baseline: adj_efficiency = walk-forward ridge on opponent-adjusted EPA (offence, defence, net), games played, neutral-site flag and team home-field EPA; climatology = expanding mean

multiple_testing: Holm across all 14 hypotheses on the TEST seasons (alpha 0.05); DEMONSTRATED also needs both halves > 0, every leave-one-season-out > 0 and a season-block CI > 0
not_claimed: no betting value: CFBD closing lines carry no quote timestamp; no Kalshi price is used
holdout_rule: 2025 outcomes are blanked before any fit unless --holdout; holdout.json is written once and is tied to this file's hash
holdout_caveat: 2025 was inside the range of the dataset builder's own walk-forward sanity check in Phase 10; it has not been used for any feature or model selection in this study
